entries.title: Royce Gracie wins UFC 1
entries.detail: Gracie submitted Art Jimmerson, Ken Shamrock and Gerard Gordeau in one night to win the first UFC tournament.
entries.imageAlt: Royce Gracie wins UFC 1 image
entries.imageMatchReason: The entry source page supplied its primary image.

entries.title: Bas Rutten stops Masakatsu Funaki at the Pancrase anniversary show
entries.detail: Rutten defeated Funaki in the 1996 Anniversary Show main event in Tokyo, retaining the King of Pancrase crown after a brutal 17-minute fight.
entries.imageAlt: Masakatsu Funaki and Bas Rutten at the 1996 Pancrase anniversary show
entries.imageMatchReason: The entry source page supplied its primary image.

entries.title: Yuki Kondo knocks out Frank Shamrock with a head kick
entries.detail: Kondo stopped Shamrock at 12:43 of their one-round bout at Pancrase 33, the promotion's 1996 Anniversary Show.
entries.imageAlt: Yuki Kondo knocks out Frank Shamrock with a head kick image
entries.imageMatchReason: Wikipedia supplied the closest directly related image.

entries.title: Josh Barnett wins the SuperBrawl 13 heavyweight tournament
entries.detail: Barnett submitted John Marsh and then beat Bobby Hoffman by unanimous decision in Honolulu to win the one-night heavyweight tournament.
entries.imageAlt: Josh Barnett wins the SuperBrawl 13 heavyweight tournament image
entries.imageMatchReason: The entry source page supplied its primary image.

entries.title: Cage Rage holds its first event in London
entries.detail: Cage Rage 1: The Beginning launched the British promotion at the Elephant and Castle Leisure Centre with 13 professional MMA bouts.

entries.title: Kiyoshi Tamura defeats Ikuhisa Minowa at DEEP 6 Impact
entries.detail: Tamura won a unanimous decision over Minowa in the openweight main event in Japan.

entries.detail: TKO, Round 2 at 1:48, to retain the UFC heavyweight championship.

entries.title: Fabricio Werdum submits Fedor Emelianenko

entries.title: Ronda Rousey becomes the first woman signed by UFC
